hiddenGems.title: Gásadalur, Faroe Islands
hiddenGems.description: Dramatic waterfall dropping directly into roaring Atlantic surf with ancient turf-roofed stone hamlets and shear basalt sea stacks.
hiddenGems.secretTips: The historic postman trail through the mountain pass offers uninterrupted fog-break vistas before tour shuttles reach the tunnel entrance.

hiddenGems.title: Salar de Uyuni, Bolivia
hiddenGems.description: Infinite cosmic mirror flats with nocturnal celestial observation camps, incandescent Milky Way reflections, and futuristic dome pods at 3,600m.
hiddenGems.bestSeason: Jan – March (Mirror effect) / May – Oct (Crisp stars)
hiddenGems.secretTips: Book during the new moon in February when a thin film of rainwater transforms the crust into an absolute zero-distortion infinite sky reflection.

hiddenGems.title: Huacachina, Peru
hiddenGems.description: Lush natural palm lagoon enclosed by towering golden dunes with midnight sandboarding, private desert glamping, and Pisco tasting.
hiddenGems.secretTips: Avoid the main lagoon perimeter at noon; head across the southwestern dune crest for sunset silence and untouched parabolic sand ripples.
